svg.aria-label: MEDIALOG printed as a home banner on rainbow fan-fold paper, and a dot-matrix printer below it printing the verbs WATCHED, READ, PLAYED and LISTENED TO
svg.title: MEDIALOG, printed in banner mode
svg.desc: Seen from above, on a navy desk. Across the top, a home banner reading MEDIALOG in giant dot-matrix letters, printed sideways across five joined sheets of fan-fold paper in pink, sky blue, canary and mint, with sprocket holes along both edges and perforations between the sheets, MediaLog's mark (an open book with a play triangle and a pen) at the left end and a heart at the right. Below it a dot-matrix printer with a VERB selector prints the next banner: WATCHED in red with popcorn, then READ in amber with a stack of books, PLAYED in green with a game pad, and LISTENED TO in teal with headphones, each torn off and carried away before the next. At the left of the verb, a torn-off slip of green-bar listing paper reads EVERYTHING YOU'VE WATCHED, READ, PLAYED, LISTENED TO, ON ONE TIMELINE, with the current verb circled in pen. A mug of tea and torn-off sprocket strips lie on the desk.
